content: Most valued ITAM reports for leadership (OfficeSpace, Oracle, InvGate, Atomicwork): cost/depreciation summary (purchase value vs current value of active assets), department-level cost attribution, lifecycle/warranty-expiry forecast, compliance/audit trail reports. For a single buyer-manager, the actionable set is: totals by type/status/department, warranty expiry forecast window, and per-employee issued list; depreciation is formal accounting and usually owned by bookkeeping, not the manager.
